status: registered before target decoding or benchmark outcomes
goal: Recover literal English for Avar Tar, Knightmare and Chayenne under a finite end-to-end decimal family, never fill by lore.
encoding: Encode uppercase English letters by fixed decimal ordinals/ASCII values, concatenate inside words, then apply a single bijective permutation of decimal digits shared by the message. No insertions/deletions, arbitrary arithmetic, alphabet substitutions or optional zero dropping. Preserve source word boundaries for fitting only.
lexicon: All distinct normalized words in existing Secret Garden and My Man Jeeves source bodies, length>=2 or A/I; no game/lore vocabulary. Deterministic normalization imported from independent_word_validator. All fits are conditional on this finite lexicon.
solver: Exact equality-pattern index and bijective-map constraint search; smallest compatible domain first; retain all partial digit mappings and word candidates. At most200000search nodes and20000partial mapping solutions per fit. Mark any truncation INCOMPLETE, never unsatisfiable. Complete digit permutations for transfer capped20000; any cap forbids unique-decoding claim.
game_split: Avar Tar first10numeric groups discovery, remaining10held transfer; Knightmare all7groups discovery with transfer to all20Avar groups and both Chayenne fragments. Full20Avar fit is separate diagnostic only, never validates prefix fit. Chayenne unspaced fragments are never assumed to be whole English words or used to fit a key.
transfer: Apply frozen surviving model/key unchanged to target. For spaced groups enumerate all exact lexicon words. For Chayenne retain all numeric-letter parse counts and conservative position consensus when unique; exact dictionary word segmentation is diagnostic, not grammar. Unseen digit assignments stay ambiguous; no best sounding completion.
qualification: 30fixtures for each of7families and7/20word lengths, alternating held authors Baum/Barrie. Fit full known-word span and decode following7words with same key. Choose fit spans wholly in frozen lexicon, without conditioning held words. Record OOV and letter-decoding ambiguity. Family supplied in benchmark; game search combines all7. Acceptance: all complete fits retain true key, no wrong singleton word, >=90%held in-lexicon words recovered uniquely. Report fail rather than silently retune.
controls: 99 per target Avar-prefix10 and Knightmare7 for each of two kinds: shuffle all digits then repartition original lengths (marginals preserved); independently shuffle each distinct numeric word once (lengths, within-word marginals, repeated words preserved). Run same seven-family search. One global digit renaming is an invariance check, not evidence of significance.
scope: Conditional finite-family and dictionary investigation; sources already exposed. No absent match excludes English, other encodings, names, inflections outside lexicon, or mistranscriptions. No grammar/semantic validation from dictionary coverage alone. No new authenticated English parallel text.
